name: RTI-32
summary: (–)-2β-Carbomethoxy-3β-(4-tolyl)tropane (RTI-4229-32, tolpane) is a phenyltropane-based cocaine analogue that has similar properties in vitro to related drugs such as RTI-31.

pharmacology.en: It blocks the dopamine transporter and also the noradrenaline transporter, so these messengers stay longer in the gaps between nerve cells.
pharmacology.zh: 它會阻斷多巴胺轉運蛋白，也阻斷正腎上腺素轉運蛋白，使這些傳導物質在神經細胞之間停留更久。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会阻断多巴胺转运蛋白，也阻断正肾上腺素转运蛋白，使这些传导物质在神经细胞之间停留更久。

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: RTI-32 differs from RTI-31 by a single group on the ring, a methyl instead of a chlorine, and the two behave very similarly. Such pairs are how chemists test what each atom contributes.
fact.zh: RTI-32 和 RTI-31 只差環上的一個基團，甲基取代了氯，兩者的表現非常相似。化學家就是用這樣的配對來測試每個原子的貢獻。
fact.zhHans: RTI-32 和 RTI-31 只差环上的一个基团，甲基取代了氯，两者的表现非常相似。化学家就是用这样的配对来测试每个原子的贡献。
